name: app-lime-green-core-values-slide-with-ai-travel-features
title: Core Values Slide in Lime and Forest Green
whatItIs: A pale slide with a numbered lime pill, a large headline 'TRU Is More Than A Booking App', and three feature cards: a dark green AI-first planning phone with floating chat bubbles, a lime card with stacked form fields, and a wide lime card with cropped booking forms.
whatItMeans: Lime and forest green feel fresh and travel-appropriate, and floating chat bubbles show the AI assistant in action.
techniques: Floating chat bubbles around a phone
Bento of dark and lime cards
Cropped forms bleeding off the card edge
Centred large headline with small subhead

vocabulary.definition: Message bubbles positioned around a device to explain AI.
A form partly cut off by its container.
A small rounded label with the section number.
